title: Urutonde rwo kwisuzuma – Jenetika
subject: Biologi
intro: Uru rutonde rukurikira intambwe z'ingenzi z'igitabo cyo kwiga. Shyiraho ikimenyetso ku byo wumva ufitiye icyizere, intambwe ku yindi. Ingingo z'ubumenyi bwimbitse ziri hasi ni iz'ushaka kujya kure kurushaho kandi zihuye n'ibice bifite ★ mu gitabo cyo kwiga.

sections.title: 1. Akagari na nucleus y'akagari (M1)
sections.note: Imiterere y'akagari isubirwamo hano mu ncamake – ibanze byigwa mu gice cyitwa «Ubuzima ni iki?».
items: Nzi ko ibinyabuzima byose bigizwe n'akagari kamwe cyangwa utugari twinshi.
Nshobora gusobanura icyo nucleus y'akagari ari cyo n'ukuntu irimo ibikoresho ngengabuzima (DNA).
Nzi ko nucleus y'akagari ikora nk'ikigo kiyobora akagari.

sections.title: 2. Chromosome na DNA (M2)
items: Nzi ko DNA ifite ishusho ya double helix.
Nshobora gusobanura ko chromosome ari DNA ipfunyitse cyane.
Nzi ko umuntu afite chromosome 46 (ibice 23 bya chromosome ebyiri-ebyiri): ibice 22 bya autosome n'igice kimwe cya chromosome y'igitsina.
Nzi itegeko ry'ibice bihuye: A ihuza na T, naho G igahuza na C.
Nzi icyo nucleotide ari cyo (igice cya sukari, igice cya fosifate n'igice cya nitrogène).
Nshobora gusobanura icyo chromosome zisa ari cyo.

sections.title: 3. Jene n'ibiranga biragwa (M3)
items: Nshobora gusobanura icyo jene ari cyo (igice cya DNA kirimo amabwiriza yo gukora proteyine).
Nzi ko jene n'ikiranga kiragwa bivuga kimwe.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu proteyine ari ingenzi cyane (zikora imirimo y'umubiri).
Nzi ko umuntu afite jene zigera ku 20 000.

sections.title: 4. Allele, genotype na phenotype (M4)
items: Nzi itandukaniro hagati ya genotype na phenotype.
Nzi icyo allele idominant n'allele iyoborwa bivuze n'uko byandikwa (A na a).
Nzi itandukaniro hagati ya homozygote na heterozygote.
Nzi icyo umutwaza ari cyo.

sections.title: 5. Gukora proteyine (M5)
items: Nzi intambwe ebyiri zo gukora proteyine: transcription na translation.
Nzi impamvu mRNA ikenewe (DNA ntiyemerewe kuva muri nucleus y'akagari).
Nshobora gusobanura icyo codon ari cyo.
Nzi icyo ribosome ikora.

sections.title: 6. Mitosis na meiosis (M6)
items: Nzi itandukaniro hagati ya mitosis na meiosis.
Nzi ko akagari k'imyororokere (gamete) gafite chromosome 23 kandi ko ari haploid.
Nshobora gusobanura icyo zygote ari cyo n'uko ari diploid (chromosome 46).
Nzi icyo amagambo haploid (umurongo umwe wa chromosome) na diploid (imirongo ibiri ya chromosome) asobanura.

sections.title: 7. Mutation (M7)
items: Nshobora gusobanura icyo mutation ari cyo.
Nzi ko mutation nyinshi zitagira ingaruka, zimwe zikaba mbi, izindi zikagira akamaro.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu ari mutation zo mu tugari tw'imyororokere gusa ziragwa.

sections.title: 8. Kuraga n'ibibaho by'ihuzwa rya Punnett (M8)
items: Nzi Gregor Mendel uwo ari we n'ibyo yavumbuye.
Nshobora gushushanya no gusobanura ikibaho cya Punnett.
Nzi ko guhuza Aa × Aa bitanga igipimo cya 3:1 mu bana.
Nshobora gusobanura icyo kuraga kwa autosome ari cyo.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu abagabo benshi kurusha abagore badatandukanya umutuku n'icyatsi.

sections.title: 9. Kuraga n'ibidukikije (M9)
items: Nshobora gusobanura ko ibiranga bigenwa n'ibyo turaga ndetse n'ibidukikije.
Nzi itandukaniro hagati y'ibiranga bigenwa na jene imwe (monogenic) n'ibigenwa na jene nyinshi (polygenic).
Nzi ko ibara ry'amaso ari ikiranga kigenwa na jene nyinshi.

sections.title: 10. Indwara ngengabuzima (M10)
items: Nzi icyo karyotype ari cyo n'icyo ikoreshwa.
Nshobora gusobanura icyateye Down syndrome (trisomy 21).
Nzi icyo bivuze kuvuga indwara ngengabuzima.

sections.title: 11. Ubuhanga bwa jene na CRISPR (M11)
items: Nshobora gusobanura icyo ubuhanga bwa jene ari cyo.
Nzi uko bagiteri zishobora gutuma zikora insuline (jene + plasmid + enzyme igabanya).
Nzi icyo CRISPR-Cas9 ari cyo.
Nzi icyo GMO ari cyo.

sections.title: ★ Ubumenyi bwimbitse
sections.note: Bihuye n'ibice bifite ★ (ubumenyi bwimbitse) mu gitabo cyo kwiga – ku ushaka kujya kure kurushaho.
items: Nshobora gusobanura codominance (ubwoko bw'amaraso AB) n'idominance idahagije.
Nshobora gusobanura icyo tRNA na anticodon bikora mu gihe cya translation.
Nshobora gusobanura crossing-over n'impamvu itera itandukaniro ngengabuzima.
Nshobora gusobanura guhuza dihybrid n'igipimo cya 9:3:3:1.
Nzi icyo PCR ari cyo n'icyo ubu buryo bukoreshwa.
Nshobora gutanga ibitekerezo ku byiza n'ibibi by'ubuhanga bwa jene.
